title: Prescription Cost Analysis – England 2025/26: integrated care board and SNOMED-level data (PCA_ICB_SNOMED_2025_2026)
authors: NHS Business Services Authority, Official Statistics Team
journal: NHS Business Services Authority Open Data Portal, Accredited Official Statistics
population: Prescription items dispensed in the community in England in the financial year 2025/26
result: Items summed by BNF chemical substance over the national file of 5 June 2026, 1,297,516,707 items in all: folic acid (BNF code 0901020G0) 9,555,632 items and a net ingredient cost of £8,853,282, rank 29 of 2047 entries in the BNF chemical substance field, which also lists appliance groups such as emollients; atorvastatin ranked first with 78,042,871 items. Sums and ranks were calculated by this site from the published file.
